places.name: Punakaiki Pancake Rocks and Blowholes
places.ai_summary: A natural wonder featuring layered limestone formations and blowholes, offering stunning coastal views.
places.place_tip: Check the tide schedule before visiting to see the blowholes in action.

attribution.title: Punakaiki MRD 01
attribution.author: Mike Dickison
attribution.description: Punakaiki is a small settlement on the West Coast of New Zealand, between Greymouth and Westport. It is known for the famous Pancake Rocks and blowholes, and is adjacent to the cliffs and lush forest of Paparoa National Park.

places.name: Franz Josef Glacier
places.ai_summary: A stunning glacier offering guided hikes, helicopter tours, and breathtaking views of the surrounding mountains.
places.place_tip: Wear warm clothing and sturdy shoes for the hike.
places.address: Franz Josef Glacier, West Coast, New Zealand

attribution.title: Franz josef Glacier LC0250

attribution.description: Franz Josef Glacier, Southern Alps, New Zealand

places.name: Hokitika Gorge
places.ai_summary: A picturesque gorge with turquoise waters, surrounded by lush native bush and walking trails.
places.place_tip: Bring a camera to capture the vibrant turquoise waters.
places.address: Hokitika Gorge, West Coast, New Zealand

places.name: Paparoa National Park
places.ai_summary: A stunning national park known for its rugged coastline, lush rainforests, and the famous Pancake Rocks.

opening_hours.notes: Visitor Centre open from 9 AM to 5 PM.

places.place_tip: Visit the Pancake Rocks at high tide for the best experience.

places.name: Westland Tai Poutini National Park
places.ai_summary: A breathtaking national park featuring glaciers, rainforests, and the stunning Tasman Sea coastline.

opening_hours.notes: Visitor Centre open from 9 AM to 5 PM.

places.place_tip: Take a guided tour to explore the glaciers safely.
places.address: State Highway 6, Franz Josef, New Zealand

places.name: Lake Matheson
places.ai_summary: A beautiful lake famous for its mirror-like reflections of the surrounding mountains.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at sunrise for stunning reflections.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera and be prepared for a short walk to the lake.
places.address: Lake Matheson, Fox Glacier, New Zealand

attribution.title: Mt Cook LC0247

attribution.description: Aoraki / Mount Cook, as seen from Hooker Valley, New Zealand.

places.name: Oparara Arches
places.ai_summary: Impressive natural arches and caves formed by the Oparara River, set in a lush rainforest.

opening_hours.notes: Access via a short walk from the car park.

places.place_tip: Explore the nearby caves and arches for a unique experience.

attribution.title: Inside Oparara Arch
attribution.author: Pseudopanax at English Wikipedia
attribution.description: View north (upstream) inside Oparara Arch, the largest natural rock arch in the southern hemisphere at 200m long, 49m wide, and 37m high. The water of the Oparara River is colored a reddish brown by natural tannins. A small waterfall can be seen in the middle inside the arch.

places.name: Shantytown Heritage Park
places.ai_summary: A living museum showcasing New Zealand's pioneering history with interactive exhibits and heritage buildings.
places.place_tip: Take a guided tour to learn about the history and stories of the area.
places.address: Shantytown, State Highway 6, Greymouth, New Zealand

places.name: Montezuma Falls Track
places.ai_summary: A scenic walking track leading to the stunning Montezuma Falls, surrounded by lush rainforest.

opening_hours.notes: Track can be slippery, wear appropriate footwear.

places.place_tip: Take your time and enjoy the diverse plant life along the track.
places.address: Montezuma Falls Track, West Coast, New Zealand

places.name: Buller Gorge Swingbridge
places.ai_summary: New Zealand's longest swing bridge, offering stunning views of the Buller Gorge and river below.

opening_hours.notes: Weather permitting, may close in high winds.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the Buller Gorge for a full day of adventure.
places.address: Buller Gorge, West Coast, New Zealand

places.name: West Coast Treetop Walk & Cafe
places.ai_summary: A unique treetop walk experience in the West Coast rainforest, with a cafe offering stunning views.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry at 4 PM, closed in high winds.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a coffee at the cafe with panoramic views of the rainforest.

places.name: Cape Foulwind Seal Colony
places.ai_summary: A protected seal colony with a viewing platform, offering close encounters with New Zealand fur seals.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at low tide for seal viewing.

places.place_tip: Observe the seals from a distance and do not disturb them.
places.address: Cape Foulwind, West Coast, New Zealand

places.ai_summary: A scenic track leading to the Welcome Flat Hot Pools, set in a beautiful alpine landscape.

opening_hours.notes: Track can be closed in winter due to snow.
